title: Serve — Baker Road Baptist Church
metaDescription: Ways to serve at Baker Road Baptist Church in Baytown: worship team, media and sound, childcare, hospitality, transportation, Sunday School and the Pumpkin Patch.
headline: Every member is a minister here.
intro: None of these need experience. Tell us what you are good at and we will find you a place.

sections.note: Not sure where you would fit? Call the office and say so. That is a normal way to start.

items.title: Worship team
items.body: Vocals and instruments, alongside our worship leader.

items.title: Media and sound
items.body: Running the slides, the sound desk, and the recording that puts each service on YouTube.

items.title: Childcare and Sunday School
items.body: Teaching, helping in a classroom, or holding babies during worship.

items.title: Hospitality
items.body: Greeting at the doors, coffee, and Wednesday night dinner in the Fellowship Hall.

items.title: Transportation
items.body: Driving the church van so people without a ride can still be here.

items.title: The Care Team
items.body: Meals, hospital visits, and prayer for people in a hard season.

items.title: The Pumpkin Patch
items.body: Dozens of shifts across two weeks, unloading pumpkins and meeting the whole of Baytown.
